nodes.name: EVEREST
nodes.summary: EVEREST is an open-source project hosted at GitHub repository Yizebaba/EVEREST-. It performs continuous true-ness audits of public Earth observation and disaster data sources by checking whether sources are online, updating on time, and producing credible values; a reporting stop is not treated as normal. When an event candidate is found, EVEREST arranges multiple independent public sources on a timeline, generates an evidence package, and applies tamper-evident storage using OpenTimestamps Bitcoin timestamps, RFC 3161 timestamps from FreeTSA and DigiCert, Sigstore signatures, and Rekor transparent logging. The platform then performs nine independent checks using two or more unrelated tools and exports W3C PROV and RO-Crate. EVEREST monitors without predicting, does not produce weather forecasts, requires every number to have a source, allows evidence to increase but not change, requires manual review before evidence is used, and does not run re-computation on GitHub Actions.
